document.title: Eval suite loads on main
document.summary: The Muse install step reads MUSE_CODE_API_KEY from its env and runs only when that value is non-empty.
document.why: Eval suite fails immediately on push to main with zero jobs. [The Muse install step references secrets in its if.](source:s1)

sources.label: Cursor session · Sep 27
sources.gist: Eval suite fails on main with zero jobs after a step if checks secrets.MUSE_CODE_API_KEY.

groups.title: Muse install gate
groups.why: The workflow fails to load when the Muse install step checks a secret in its if. [That run finished with no jobs.](source:s1)
groups.summary: The install step maps the Muse key into env and skips itself when that value is empty.

commits.subject: Fix Eval suite workflow load by checking the Muse key via env
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
GitHub rejects a step if that names the secrets context, so the workflow never starts. The Muse install step now maps MUSE_CODE_API_KEY into step env and gates on that.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>
